excerpt: Figure 4 describes Ansor's architecture: DNNs are partitioned into subgraphs, a program sampler performs sketch generation and random annotation, a performance tuner applies evolutionary search with a learned cost model, and a measurer returns execution-time data for Intel CPU, ARM CPU, NVIDIA GPU, and other targets.
overview: This evidence establishes that Ansor is not a single optimization pass. Its argument depends on a coordinated pipeline: divide neural networks into tunable subgraphs, generate diverse complete tensor programs, refine them using a learned model, and use measurements to update future search. The excerpt grounds claims about automated tensor-program generation and the roles of the sampler, tuner, and scheduler.
title: Three-Component Ansor Architecture
